title: Como o alarme chega no seu pulso
concept: Blueprint FIG. 3: a line-art smartwatch buzzes with a KizuBot alarm, then a packet travels a 4-node pipeline (nuvem → IA → zap → pulso) with a real artefact at each stop — the bot playing in the cloud 24/7 with the PC off, the real alarm names, a real KizuBot WhatsApp alarm (with 'KizuBot™| kizubot.com' inside), the alarm on a real wrist (drop) — and a customer's verdict: 'Chega certinho'.
hook: COMO O ALARME CHEGA NO PULSO?
claims: roda 24/7 na nuvem; uso com PC desligado
detecção de shinys, megas e bosses (nomes reais dos alarmes: shinyDetected, megaDetected, bossDetected)
print real de cliente: "Ativei msgs pelo zap também" / "Chega certinho" (verbatim)

tiktok.caption: Como o alarme do KizuBot chega no seu pulso? ⌚ O bot joga na nuvem, a IA detecta shiny, mega e boss, manda no WhatsApp ou Telegram e chega até no relógio. Prints reais de clientes diferentes. Link na bio.

pinned_comment: Você prefere alarme no WhatsApp ou no Telegram?
notes: Hook shortened from 'COMO O ALARME CHEGA NO SEU PULSO.' (7 words) to 'COMO O ALARME CHEGA NO PULSO?' (6), set as 4 lines (Chakra Petch is wide). Pipeline simplified to 4 stops (jogo/servidor merged into 'nuvem'; WhatsApp/Telegram + celular merged into 'zap'). Concept sources mapped to ASSETS slugs: boss-tangrowth-electivire.png → boss-tangrowth-electivire--tangrowth.png (real alarm format with 'KizuBot™| kizubot.com', nick pilled); smartwatch-alarm.jpg → smartwatch-alarm--photo.jpg; trampo-da-hora.png → trampo-da-hora--zap.png. Three different customers → 'prints reais de clientes diferentes' shown on screen; every print tagged 'print real de cliente'; the boss alarm and the watch alarm (dropStone) are different events and are not presented as the same alarm (the packet carries a generic alarm). The KizuBot 'alert' sound plays on the two watch-alarm moments. Mono labels render with font-variant-ligatures: none. Loop bridge returns to the hook.
